doc.title: Howard Levy interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, November 11, 2025

title: Bunky Green and the Northwestern jazz band
summary: Bunky Green led the band and was the first heavy jazz player Levy played alongside.

story.theme_name: First paying gigs: getting started as a young professional
story.community_name: First paid gigs: pay, bands and young beginnings

blocks.x: And so Bunky was the first heavy jazz player that I ever got to play alongside of. And you know the first time he took his horn out and played I was just like ooh, who is this guy you know. Because at that time people really, outside of Chicago, didn’t know who Bunky Green was in 1969.
